Aa.text: This letter is A. It makes the ah sound, like in father. The picture word means tree.

Bb.text: This letter is Be. It makes the sound at the start of bear. The picture word means boat.

Cc.text: This letter is Ce. It makes the sound at the start of kite. The picture word means house.

Dd.text: This letter is De. It makes the sound at the start of dog. The picture word means dolphin.

Ee.text: This letter is E. It makes the eh sound, like in egg. The picture word means elephant.

Ff.text: This letter is Efe. It makes the sound at the start of fish. The picture word means flower.

Gg.text: This letter is Ge. It makes the sound at the start of goat. The picture word means cat.

Ii.text: This letter is I. It makes the ee sound, like in see. The picture word means iguana.

Jj.text: This letter is Jota. It makes a breathy h sound, from the throat. The picture word means giraffe.

Ll.text: This letter is Ele. It makes the sound at the start of lion. The picture word means moon.

Mm.text: This letter is Eme. It makes the sound at the start of moon. The picture word means mom.

Nn.text: This letter is Ene. It makes the sound at the start of nest. The picture word means cloud.

Ññ.text: This letter is Enye. It makes the ny sound in the middle of canyon. The picture word means rhea, a big bird.

Oo.text: This letter is O. It makes the o sound, like in go. The picture word means bear.

Pp.text: This letter is Pe. It makes the sound at the start of pig. The picture word means dog.

Rr.text: This letter is Erre. It makes a rolled r. The picture word means mouse.

Ss.text: This letter is Ese. It makes the sound at the start of sun. The picture word means sun.

Tt.text: This letter is Te. It makes the sound at the start of turtle. The picture word means turtle.

Uu.text: This letter is U. It makes the oo sound, like in moon. The picture word means grape.

Vv.text: This letter is Uve. It makes the sound at the start of bear. The picture word means cow.

Zz.text: This letter is Zeta. It makes the sound at the start of sun. The picture word means shoe.
